notes: Six complete direction headings: 40 visually reviewed rows, 38 accepted individually printed nonstop schedules, one through-stop row excluded and one source conflict held. All accepted rows use the ASA triangle and operator ranges from p4; no dated footnotes.
Blank means daily; X6 excludes Saturday; X7 excludes Sunday; X67 excludes both Saturday and Sunday. Both ATL–DHN and DHN–ATL 1256 have X67. Own weekdays are preserved for each physical leg.

ATL–HSV westbound rows may print identical departure and arrival clock times; these are one-hour flights after winter timezone conversion. ATL–DHN 1254/1255/1256/1258 have a five-minute clock difference but are 65-minute flights.

HSV–ATL 1412 reads 800a–800a in the nonstop heading, implying minus 60 minutes after timezone conversion. The same-origin connecting rows 1412/1201 to Albany and 1412/428 to Augusta both print 600a on p107. This conflicting row is held, not silently changed to 0600 or the next day.

DHN–ATL 1481 at 19:05–22:10 has one stop. The itinerary key p264 gives ATL–DHN–PFN–ATL. Only its individually printed ATL–DHN 18:45–18:55 leg is added now; no DHN–ATL nonstop is created. Intermediate legs remain for later source review.
ATL–AVL 1219 departs 20:25, ATL–DHN 1256 runs 12:05–12:10, and DHN–ATL 1256 runs 12:25–14:30. Enlarged original rows confirm these readings.

ATL/AVL use winter UTC−5; DHN/HSV use UTC−6. All accepted arrivals are on the same local calendar day. Independent 24-hour transcription, fixed offsets and exact window overlap match all generated movements.
Sixteen same-number returns on 28 February have independently checked ground intervals of 15 or 20 minutes. This validates segment continuity, not aircraft identity.

Directory p260 identifies AVL Regional, DHN Dothan-Houston County and HSV Huntsville-Madison County. Airport authority histories confirm the respective current fields opened before 1986; older replaced airfields are not used. Modern coordinates mark approximate airport areas.

All previous movements, schedules, airlines and airports unchanged; prior COMAIR corrections and held conflicts preserved. Timetable end date, later amendments and actual operation remain unverified. Original scans are not redistributed.
